title: Non-Classic CAH, 11-Beta and 17-Alpha Hydroxylase Deficiencies: Blood Pressure Signatures
subject: ss-paediatric-endocrinology
module: Adrenal Cortex, CAH and Differences of Sex Development

steps.say: Non-classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia is a common cause of premature pubarche and hyperandrogenism.
steps.tx: Characterize **Non-classic CAH (NCCAH) genetics and frequency** in children presenting with premature adrenarche. NCCAH is an autosomal recessive condition affecting 1 in 200 to 1 in 1000 individuals (higher in Ashkenazi Jews), caused by mild CYP21A2 missense variants (e.g., p.Val281Leu) retaining 20-50% enzyme activity.

vis.alt: Cross-sectional diagram of the adrenal cortex showing zona glomerulosa, zona fasciculata, and zona reticularis steroidogenic zonation.
vis.caption: Adrenal cortex functional zonation separating mineralocorticoid, glucocorticoid, and androgen synthesis.

steps.say: A standard cosyntropin stimulation test establishes the definitive endocrine diagnosis of non-classic disease.
steps.tx: Perform a **Cosyntropin stimulation test in NCCAH** to confirm impaired 21-hydroxylation capacity. Diagnosis of NCCAH is established by a 60-minute cosyntropin (ACTH 250 mcg) stimulation test yielding stimulated 17-OHP > 30 nmol/L (> 1000 ng/dL); basal levels may be normal or mildly elevated.

steps.say: 11-beta hydroxylase deficiency combines adrenal androgen excess with low-renin mineralocorticoid hypertension.
steps.tx: Recognize **11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency (CYP11B1) hypertension** in virilized pediatric patients. Deficiency of CYP11B1 (5-8% of CAH) causes accumulation of 11-deoxycorticosterone (DOC, a potent mineralocorticoid) and 11-deoxycortisol, producing severe low-renin hypertension and hypokalemia alongside female virilization. Management relies on oral hydrocortisone replacement to suppress excessive pituitary ACTH secretion and normalize systemic arterial pressures.

steps.say: 17-alpha hydroxylase deficiency blocks both cortisol and sex steroid production, causing pubertal failure and hypertension.
steps.tx: Identify **17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency (CYP17A1) sexual infantilism** in adolescents with hypertension and delayed puberty. CYP17A1 deficiency blocks both cortisol and sex steroid production, causing massive mineralocorticoid excess (hypertension, hypokalemia) combined with sexual infantilism in 46,XX and female external genitalia in 46,XY.

left.title: 46,XY Genetic Males
points: Complete female external genitalia with blind-ending vagina
Absent internal female reproductive organs (intact AMH)
Severe pubertal failure with hypergonadotropic hypogonadism

right.title: 46,XX Genetic Females
points: Normal infantile female genitalia at birth
Primary amenorrhea with sexual infantilism and absent thelarche

steps.tx: One missing enzyme produces the unusual pairing of high blood pressure with absent puberty. Blocking **17 alpha hydroxylase** stops cortisol and all sex steroid synthesis, so androgens and estrogens never appear, while steroid flow diverts into deoxycorticosterone, which retains salt and raises pressure. The pathway picture shows both halves at once: the swollen mineralocorticoid branch and the empty branches beyond the block.
steps.say: Blocking 17 alpha hydroxylase removes cortisol and sex steroids, so puberty fails. Steroid flow diverts into deoxycorticosterone, which retains salt and raises blood pressure.

vis.alt: Steroid pathway chart with a block at 17 alpha hydroxylase, cortisol and sex steroid branches fading while mineralocorticoid products accumulate.
vis.caption: 17 alpha hydroxylase block causing hypertension with absent puberty and low androgen production. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.say: 3-beta hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase deficiency impairs all three steroid pathways in both adrenals and gonads.
steps.tx: Evaluate the lesions of **3-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase deficiency (HSD3B2)** presenting in early infancy. HSD3B2 deficiency impairs all three steroid pathways, producing severe salt wasting, elevated DHEA-to-androstenedione ratio, ambiguous genitalia in 46,XY (undervirilization) and mild virilization in 46,XX. Treatment requires immediate stress-dose glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid replacement alongside urgent correction of life-threatening electrolyte derangements.

vis.title: HSD3B2 Deficiency Phenotype and Steroids
rows: Severe mineralocorticoid, cortisol and androgen deficiency
Incomplete male virilization / mild female virilization

steps.say: Lipoid congenital adrenal hyperplasia disrupts the initial transport of cholesterol into the mitochondria.
steps.tx: Recognize the catastrophic collapse in **Congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia (StAR mutation)** in neonates. Mutations in steroidogenic acute regulatory protein (StAR) prevent cholesterol entry into mitochondria, producing complete absence of all steroids, fatal neonatal salt-wasting, and female phenotype in all genetic sexes.

vis.title: StAR Defect and Steroidogenic Shutdown

nodes.label: Fatal Salt-Wasting Crisis & Female External Phenotype

edges: Severe adrenal shock within 2 weeks of life

steps.say: P450 oxidoreductase deficiency couples disordered steroidogenesis with skeletal craniosynostosis.
steps.tx: Identify the multi-system syndrome of **P450 oxidoreductase deficiency (Antley-Bixler phenotype)** in infants. POR deficiency impairs multiple microsomal enzymes (CYP21A2, CYP17A1, CYP51A1), causing disordered steroidogenesis alongside skeletal craniosynostosis (Antley-Bixler syndrome) and maternal virilization during pregnancy. Multidisciplinary management is essential to address complex craniofacial remodeling, respiratory stability, and longitudinal pediatric endocrine hormone replacement.

vis.title: POR Deficiency: Triad of Clinical Findings
rows: Partial adrenal insufficiency and ambiguous genitalia
Maternal virilization, clitoromegaly, deep voice regressing postpartum

steps.say: Blood pressure and plasma renin activity definitively distinguish between the two major virilizing forms of CAH.
steps.tx: Establish protocolized rules for **Differentiating 21-OH from 11-OH deficiency** in virilized infants. Both 21-OH and 11-OH deficiencies virilize female fetuses; the critical differentiator is blood pressure and renin: 21-OH features hypotension, salt loss, and high renin, whereas 11-OH features hypertension and suppressed renin.

left.title: 21-Hydroxylase Deficiency (CYP21A2)
points: Hypotension, salt wasting, and hypovolemic shock
Markedly elevated plasma renin activity (high renin)
